about.photo_alt: Finished walkway with The Savior Concrete Company yard sign
about.title: Small, family owned, and proud of every pour
paragraphs: The Savior Concrete Company is a small family-owned business that prides itself in top quality concrete for your home, building or residence, with over 20 years of experience.
We received our education at the World of Concrete in Las Vegas, and our knowledge was formed through years of partnering with companies large and small.
No matter the size of the project, we take pride in excellent work, competitive fees and outstanding results on time, every time, because we value your time and money.

estimate.title: Let's talk about your project.
estimate.text: Tell us about your project and we'll get back to you with a free estimate. Prices vary with materials and labor, so every quote is built for your job.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon to set up your free estimate.

services.name: Driveways & Slabs
services.blurb: Driveways, garage floors, basement floors and slabs.
services.intro: From new driveways to garage and basement floors, we pour slabs that look good and hold up.

services.name: Patios
services.blurb: Backyard patios in any finish, from broom to stamped.
services.intro: A new patio gives you more room to live outdoors. We build them in any finish you like.

services.name: Walkways & Sidewalks
services.blurb: Walkways, paths and sidewalks that make your home easy to get around.
services.intro: Straight or curved, plain or decorative, we build walkways and sidewalks that last.

services.name: Steps & Retaining Walls
services.blurb: Steps, stairs and retaining walls built for strength and looks.
services.intro: Steps and retaining walls take careful forming and finishing. We handle both, together or on their own.

services.name: Decorative & Stamped Concrete
services.blurb: Stamped, colored, exposed aggregate, sand finish and acid stain.

services.intro: We build ADA-compliant ramps, curbs and sidewalks for cities and commercial properties.
